title: Samsung all but confirms iPhone Duo is goosing Galaxy Z8 sales
gist: Samsung UK says combined European sales of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Z Fold 8 Ultra are up 45 percent from the Z Fold 7, and European Z8 search volume jumped 460 percent in the week Apple announced the iPhone Duo (September 9). Ryan Whitwam argues that Apple's entry is legitimizing foldables and pushing the industry toward wider, iPhone-like form factors. He notes that foldable prices ($2,000 iPhone Duo, $1,900 wide Z Fold 8) are now only a few hundred dollars above flagship flat phones.

themes.theme: iPhone Duo halo effect on Samsung foldable sales

insights.claim: Samsung UK says combined European sales of the Galaxy Z Fold 8 and Z Fold 8 Ultra are up 45 percent compared with the Galaxy Z Fold 7. Samsung did not disclose Z Flip 8 sales.
insights.speaker: Ryan Whitwam
insights.so_what: Shows foldable demand is accelerating at Samsung, a positive read-through for its mobile division and display suppliers.
insights.locator: In a new blog post, Samsung

insights.claim: Search volume for Samsung's Galaxy Z8 series across Europe spiked 460 percent in the week of September 6 to 12, which included Apple's September 9 iPhone Duo announcement. Z Fold 8 search volume for all of September was up 260 percent.
insights.speaker: Ryan Whitwam
insights.so_what: The timing suggests Apple's entry is growing overall interest in the foldable category rather than only taking share from it.
insights.locator: The reason for flat Z Flip

insights.claim: Ryan Whitwam suggests Samsung's Z Flip 8 sales were probably flat because Apple did not release a flip-style phone. He notes that Samsung's larger foldables already made up about 80 percent of its foldable purchases.
insights.speaker: Ryan Whitwam
insights.so_what: Apple's halo effect seems limited to the book-style form factor it entered, so flip-phone demand is not getting a boost.
insights.locator: The reason for flat Z Flip

insights.claim: Samsung said US preorders for the Galaxy Z8 series were trending 30 percent above the previous year. Third-party reports say Samsung is ramping up foldable manufacturing, especially of the wider, iPhone-like Z Fold 8.
insights.speaker: Ryan Whitwam
insights.so_what: A production ramp points to more component orders, especially foldable display panels.

themes.theme: Foldable form-factor shift toward wider screens

insights.claim: The iPhone Duo uses many of the same components as other foldable phones, including Samsung displays. Apple's foldable therefore depends on a supply chain Samsung built after launching its first foldable in 2019.
insights.speaker: Ryan Whitwam
insights.so_what: Samsung gains both ways: from its own device sales and from supplying displays for Apple's foldable.
insights.quote: The iPhone Duo is not an island—it relies on many of the same components as other foldable phones, including Samsung displays.

insights.claim: Ryan Whitwam argues that the wider foldable form factor fixes real problems: less wasted space when watching video, and better portrait use for documents and unoptimized Play Store apps than square foldable screens. He expects other OEMs to copy it in the coming months.
insights.speaker: Ryan Whitwam
insights.so_what: Expect Android OEMs to launch wide foldables, which would add to foldable panel demand.

insights.claim: Samsung likely added the non-Ultra wide Z Fold 8 to its lineup in response to leaks about Apple's device, getting it to market just in time.

insights.so_what: Shows Samsung shaping its product roadmap in reaction to Apple.

themes.theme: Foldable pricing converging with flagship flat phones

insights.claim: After recent price hikes, the top flat phones from Samsung, Google and Apple are only a few hundred dollars cheaper than their foldable options. Foldable prices have risen too, but by less, which narrows the premium for foldables.
insights.speaker: Ryan Whitwam
insights.so_what: A smaller foldable premium could speed up adoption and raise average selling prices across smartphone lineups.

insights.claim: Apple priced the iPhone Duo at $2,000, which the author calls uncharacteristically competitive for a foldable. Samsung's wide Z Fold 8 costs $1,900 and has been discounted at a few retailers since launch.
insights.speaker: Ryan Whitwam
insights.so_what: Retailer discounts on the Z Fold 8 hint at early pressure on Samsung's margins as it competes with Apple.
